Its EEG signature shows elevated γ (+0.3 dB, sensitivity=4.3) and elevated β_h (+1.2 dB, sensitivity=2.0).
The γ activity is present in 0% of each epoch (transient), with quiescent eye movements (SEM 28% active) and atonic muscle tone.
This is coherent with N2 physiology: σ elevated, σ relevant, EOG quiescent — all confirmed. Note: model primarily uses γ, atypical for N2.
